# Lucihub

> > Lucihub is an AI-powered video production platform offering collaborative cloud editing, Creative Copilot AI for script and storyboard generation, and managed video services for enterprises, agencies, and content creators.

Lucihub combines cloud-based video production tools with AI assistance to streamline workflows from concept to final edit. The platform features Creative Copilot, an AI creative director that generates scripts, shot lists, and storyboards, alongside professional editing services and enterprise solutions with partnerships including Microsoft.
